cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your sister's bringing her future self to dinner. Reserve two chairs for her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Use mine. I won't make either of her eat standing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put the extra chair beside hers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'tomorrow' on its place card. I need to know which one can tell me how tonight went.

mechanism: A directs seating and labeling choices that only make sense if the sister and her future self both attend.
confusable: Unlike talking about time travel abstractly, A allocates A's own chair and orders an identifying place card.
comparison: A second self at dinner differs from feeding an architectural surface.
seedUse: The seed already assigns chairs and labels while A yields a resource, making S01 a cooperative authority rather than an argument.
